instructions: This directory contains application configuration files and constants.
- Use TypeScript for all configuration files
- Export constants with descriptive names in UPPER_CASE
- Keep sensitive configuration in environment variables
- Document configuration options with clear comments
- Use proper TypeScript typing for configuration objects
- Group related constants together in logical files
- Provide sensible defaults for optional configuration
- Use consistent naming patterns across configuration files

files.constants.ts: Application constants including model settings and prompts

patterns.model_config: Use MODEL constant for OpenAI model selection
patterns.functions: Map function names to implementations in functionsMap
